hypothesis_en: Consolidate the existing conditional policy into one authoritative priority order per native model call: actual action destinations and changed procedures/conditions remain protected before finite localization/template exceptions, and whole-document coverage precedes label or category inference. Actual candidate04 outputs explicitly let a late city exception override a real submission address, treated direct password entry as equivalent to emailed-link activation, and revised a judgment without updating its earlier ledger. Remove repeated semantic appendices from pair prompts and rubric descriptions while retaining original padded evidence, exact native JSON fences, fifteen main fields, eight/seven/four critic schemas, enums, authority, code, model and window. This is a policy-expression/precedence experiment on candidate03, not an expansion to UI selectors/facets or arbitrary identities. Earlier full rewrites had format/evidence changes and bare-JSON failures; this version preserves the native fenced contract and byte-identical packet/truncation rendering, then must pass real hard screens before long scoring.
hypothesis_zh: 将既有条件政策合并为每次原生模型调用中的一套权威优先顺序：实际操作入口及流程或条件变化先于有限的本地化及模板例外受到保护，全文覆盖先于名称或分类推断。candidate04原始输出曾明确让后面的城市例外覆盖真实投稿地址，将直接输入密码视为与邮件链接激活等价，并修改判断却未同步先前字段。移除pair提示及rubric描述中重复的语义附录，同时保留原有填充证据、精确的原生JSON代码围栏、十五个主字段、八个或七个或四个critic字段结构、枚举、权限、代码、模型及窗口。这是在candidate03基础上进行的政策表达及优先级实验，不扩展到界面选择器、筛选项或任意身份。此前完整改写曾同时更改格式或证据并出现裸JSON失败；本版保留原生围栏约束及逐字相同的证据包和截断呈现，须先通过真实硬回归才进行长评分。
reason_en: Policy consolidation strongly increased required-Yes errors, including previously stable citation, category, introduction and heading cases. Zero raw wrong allows does not compensate for these required coverage failures. Reject without long scoring; preserve the failed full86screen.
reason_zh: 政策合并显著增加必须为Yes的错误，包括此前较稳定的引用、分类、引言及标题情况。原始错误允许为零不能抵消这些必须正确覆盖的失败。不进行长评分即淘汰，并保留失败的完整86项回归。
